SELECT DISTINCT ?botanist ?botanistLabel WHERE {
  ?botanist wdt:P106 wd:Q2374149 .
  ?botanist rdfs:label ?botanistLabel .
  FILTER(LANG(?botanistLabel) = "en")
  FILTER(STRSTARTS(?botanistLabel, "H"))
}
ORDER BY ?botanistLabel
LIMIT 100

SELECT ?lexeme ?lemma (COUNT(?part) AS ?count) WHERE {
  ?lexeme wikibase:lemma ?lemma .
  ?lexeme wdt:P5238 ?part .
}
GROUP BY ?lexeme ?lemma
ORDER BY DESC(?count)
LIMIT 100

SELECT DISTINCT ?person ?personLabel ?birthDate ?deathDate WHERE {
  ?person wdt:P31 wd:Q5 .
  ?person wdt:P21 wd:Q6581097 .
  ?person wdt:P27 wd:Q30 .

  ?person p:P569 ?birthStatement .
  ?birthStatement psv:P569 ?birthValue .
  ?birthValue wikibase:timeValue ?birthDate .
  ?birthValue wikibase:timePrecision ?birthPrecision .
  FILTER(?birthPrecision = 9)

  ?person p:P570 ?deathStatement .
  ?deathStatement psv:P570 ?deathValue .
  ?deathValue wikibase:timeValue ?deathDate .
  ?deathValue wikibase:timePrecision ?deathPrecision .
  FILTER(?deathPrecision = 11)

  FILTER(YEAR(?birthDate) >= 1875 && YEAR(?birthDate) <= 1930)

  SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "en". }
}

SELECT DISTINCT ?watercraft ?watercraftLabel WHERE {
  ?watercraft wdt:P31/wdt:P279* wd:Q1229765 .
  ?watercraft wdt:P17 wd:Q142 .
  ?watercraft rdfs:label ?watercraftLabel .
  FILTER(LANG(?watercraftLabel) = "en")
  FILTER(STRSTARTS(?watercraftLabel, "A"))
}

SELECT DISTINCT ?film ?filmLabel WHERE {
  ?film wdt:P31 wd:Q11424 .
  ?film wdt:P364 wd:Q188 .
  ?film rdfs:label ?filmLabel .
  FILTER(LANG(?filmLabel) = "de")
  FILTER(CONTAINS(LCASE(?filmLabel), "antwortet nicht"))
}

SELECT ?item ?url ?statements WHERE {
  ?item wdt:P195 wd:Q636400 .
  ?item wdt:[property:Jameel Centre at the Ashmolean Museum ID] ?id .
  ?item wikibase:statements ?statements .
  BIND(IRI(CONCAT("https://jameelcentre.ashmolean.org/collection/", ?id)) AS ?url)
}
ORDER BY DESC(?statements)

SELECT ?year (COUNT(DISTINCT ?seat) AS ?count) WHERE {
  ?statement pq:[qualifier:replaces] ?seat .
  ?member p:P39 ?statement .
  ?statement ps:P39 wd:Q18952564 .
  ?statement pq:[qualifier:start time] ?start .
  BIND(YEAR(?start) AS ?year)
  FILTER(?year >= 1830 && ?year <= 1910)
}
GROUP BY ?year
ORDER BY ?year

SELECT DISTINCT ?lang WHERE {
  wd:Q137 rdfs:label ?label1 .
  wd:Q12518 rdfs:label ?label2 .
  BIND(LANG(?label1) AS ?lang1)
  BIND(LANG(?label2) AS ?lang2)
  FILTER(?lang1 = ?lang2)
  BIND(?lang1 AS ?lang)
}

SELECT ?author ?authorLabel (SUM(?citations) AS ?totalCitations) WHERE {
  ?author wdt:P27 wd:Q35.
  ?author wdt:P106 wd:Q482980.
  ?work wdt:P50 ?author.
  ?work wdt:P248 ?citingWork.
  BIND(1 AS ?citations)
  SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "en". }
}
GROUP BY ?author ?authorLabel
ORDER BY DESC(?totalCitations)
LIMIT 20

SELECT ?decade (COUNT(?person) AS ?count) WHERE {
  ?person wdt:P31 wd:Q5 .
  ?person wdt:P19 ?birthPlace .
  ?birthPlace wdt:P17 wd:Q213 .
  ?person wdt:P20 ?deathPlace .
  ?deathPlace wdt:P17 wd:Q183 .
  ?person wdt:P569 ?birthDate .
  BIND(FLOOR(YEAR(?birthDate)/10)*10 AS ?decade)
}
GROUP BY ?decade
ORDER BY ?decade

SELECT DISTINCT ?firstLetter WHERE {
  ?software wdt:P31 wd:Q341 .
  ?software rdfs:label ?label .
  FILTER(LANG(?label) = "en")
  BIND(SUBSTR(?label, 1, 1) AS ?firstLetter)
}
ORDER BY ?firstLetter

SELECT ?person ?personLabel (COUNT(?article) AS ?pageCount) WHERE {
  ?person wdt:P570 ?dod .
  FILTER(YEAR(?dod) = 2018)
  ?person wdt:P31 wd:Q5 .
  ?article schema:about ?person .
  ?article schema:isPartOf ?site .
  FILTER(CONTAINS(STR(?site), "wikipedia.org"))
  SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "en". }
}
GROUP BY ?person ?personLabel
ORDER BY DESC(?pageCount)

SELECT DISTINCT ?songLabel WHERE {
  ?song wdt:P31 wd:Q7366 .
  ?name wdt:P31 wd:Q11879590 .
  ?song rdfs:label ?songLabel .
  ?name rdfs:label ?nameLabel .
  FILTER(LANG(?songLabel) = "en")
  FILTER(LANG(?nameLabel) = "en")
  FILTER(?songLabel = ?nameLabel)
}

SELECT ?century (COUNT(DISTINCT ?person) AS ?count) WHERE {
  ?person wdt:P31 wd:Q5 .
  ?person wdt:P172 wd:Q47588 .
  ?person wdt:P19 ?birthplace .
  ?person wdt:P570 ?deathDate .
  BIND(FLOOR((YEAR(?deathDate) - 1) / 100) + 1 AS ?century)
}
GROUP BY ?century
ORDER BY ?century

SELECT DISTINCT ?person ?personLabel WHERE {
  ?person wdt:P31 wd:Q5 .
  ?person wdt:P166 ?award1 .
  ?award1 wdt:P17 ?country1 .
  ?award1 wdt:P31/wdt:P279* wd:Q1788716 .
  ?person wdt:P166 ?award2 .
  ?award2 wdt:P17 ?country2 .
  ?award2 wdt:P31/wdt:P279* wd:Q1788716 .
  FILTER(?country1 != ?country2)
  SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "en". }
}

SELECT DISTINCT ?country ?countryLabel ?capital ?capitalLabel WHERE {
  ?country wdt:P31 wd:Q6256 .
  ?country wdt:P36 ?capital .
  ?country rdfs:label ?countryLabel .
  ?capital rdfs:label ?capitalLabel .
  FILTER(LANG(?countryLabel) = "en")
  FILTER(LANG(?capitalLabel) = "en")
  FILTER(REGEX(LCASE(?capitalLabel), CONCAT("^[", LCASE(REPLACE(?countryLabel, "[^A-Za-z]", "")), " ]+$")))
}

SELECT DISTINCT ?person1 ?person1Label ?person2 ?person2Label ?place1Label ?place2Label WHERE {
  ?person1 wdt:P3373 ?person2 .
  ?person1 wdt:P569 ?dob1 .
  ?person2 wdt:P569 ?dob2 .
  FILTER(?dob1 = ?dob2)
  FILTER(STR(?person1) < STR(?person2))
  ?person1 wdt:P19 ?place1 .
  ?person2 wdt:P19 ?place2 .
  FILTER(?place1 != ?place2)
  SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "en". }
}

SELECT DISTINCT ?artist ?artistLabel WHERE {
  ?artist wdt:P31 wd:Q5 .
  ?artist wdt:P106 wd:Q483501 .
  ?artist wdt:P569 ?dob .
  ?artist wdt:P735 ?givenName .
  ?artist wdt:P734 ?familyName .
  ?givenName rdfs:label ?givenNameLabel .
  ?familyName rdfs:label ?familyNameLabel .
  FILTER(LANG(?givenNameLabel) = "en")
  FILTER(LANG(?familyNameLabel) = "en")
  FILTER(STRSTARTS(?givenNameLabel, "D"))
  FILTER(STRSTARTS(?familyNameLabel, "K"))
  FILTER(YEAR(?dob) >= 1880 && YEAR(?dob) <= 1944)
  SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "en". }
}

SELECT ?person ?personLabel ?birthYear ?deathYear ?birthPlaceLabel ?deathPlaceLabel WHERE {
  ?person wdt:P31 wd:Q5 .
  ?person wdt:P569 ?birthDate .
  ?person wdt:P570 ?deathDate .
  ?person wdt:P19 ?birthPlace .
  ?person wdt:P20 ?deathPlace .
  BIND(YEAR(?birthDate) AS ?birthYear)
  BIND(YEAR(?deathDate) AS ?deathYear)
  SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "en". }
}
LIMIT 100

SELECT ?place1 ?place1Label ?coord1 ?place2 ?place2Label ?coord2 ?line WHERE {
  ?place1 wdt:P31 wd:Q484170 .
  ?place2 wdt:P31 wd:Q484170 .
  ?place1 rdfs:label ?name .
  ?place2 rdfs:label ?name .
  FILTER(?place1 != ?place2)
  ?place1 wdt:P625 ?coord1 .
  ?place2 wdt:P625 ?coord2 .
  FILTER(?place1 < ?place2)
  BIND(CONCAT("LINESTRING(", 
    STR(?coord1), ",", STR(?coord2), ")") AS ?lineWKT)
  BIND(STRDT(CONCAT("LINESTRING(", 
    STRAFTER(STRBEFORE(STR(?coord1),")"),"("), ",", 
    STRAFTER(STRBEFORE(STR(?coord2),")"),"("), ")"), 
    geo:wktLiteral) AS ?line)
  SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "en,fr". }
}

SELECT ?country ?countryLabel (COUNT(DISTINCT ?person) AS ?count) WHERE {
  ?person wdt:P31 wd:Q5 .
  ?person wdt:P27 ?country .
  ?person wdt:P735 ?givenName .
  ?givenName rdfs:label ?givenNameLabel .
  FILTER(LANG(?givenNameLabel) = "en")
  FILTER(STRSTARTS(?givenNameLabel, "X") || STRSTARTS(?givenNameLabel, "Q"))
  SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "en". }
}
GROUP BY ?country ?countryLabel
ORDER BY DESC(?count)
LIMIT 20

SELECT DISTINCT ?politician ?politicianLabel ?age WHERE {
  ?politician wdt:P31 wd:Q5 .
  ?politician wdt:P27 wd:Q38 .
  ?politician wdt:P106 wd:Q82955 .
  ?politician wdt:P39 ?position .
  ?position wdt:P279* wd:Q83307 .
  ?politician wdt:P569 ?dob .
  BIND(YEAR(NOW()) - YEAR(?dob) AS ?age)
  FILTER(?age >= 50 && ?age <= 80)
  SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "en". }
}

SELECT ?streetLabel (COUNT(?street) AS ?count) WHERE {
  ?street wdt:P31 wd:Q79007 .
  ?street wdt:P131 ?admin .
  ?admin wdt:P131* wd:Q64 .
  ?street rdfs:label ?streetLabel .
  FILTER(LANG(?streetLabel) = "de")
}
GROUP BY ?streetLabel
HAVING(COUNT(?street) > 1)
ORDER BY DESC(?count)

SELECT ?head ?headLabel ?startTime ?endTime ?duration WHERE {
  ?head wdt:P39 ?position .
  ?position wdt:P1001 wd:Q142 .
  ?head p:P39 ?statement .
  ?statement pq:P580 ?startTime .
  ?statement pq:P582 ?endTime .
  ?position wdt:P31 wd:Q2285706 .
  BIND(?endTime - ?startTime AS ?duration)
  SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "en". }
}
ORDER BY DESC(?duration)
LIMIT 10
